description: Labeled intents for measuring Copilot Studio hybrid tool-selection accuracy. Each prompt is tagged with the tool(s) the copilot SHOULD invoke; run through the hybrid agent and read the Activity tab to record observed tools. Tools: lookupHRPolicyDocument (Pattern C locator), askHRPolicy (Pattern B/Hosted content synthesis), knowledge_base (Pattern A/A2 native Knowledge Source).
source: docs/CopilotStudioTestingGuide.md (Scenario C, Scenario Hy) and docs/CopilotStudioHybridExample.md
